product_metadata.title: iDesign Plastic Soap Dish, Soap Saver, and Kitchen Sponge Holder - Set of 3, 0.75” x 3.25” x 4.75”, Clear
features: BAR SOAP HOLDER – The iDesign Set of 3 Plastic Soap Dish keeps bar soap at hand near the sink and protects surfaces from soap residue and excess water
VERSATILE USES - The kitchen soap tray accommodates most brands of bar soap and is a great holder for sponges, scrubbies, dish brushes, razors, small accessories, and more

FUNCTIONAL - Raised bumps along surface securely holds soap and acts as a dish sponge holder; raised based on the kitchen sponge holder for sink allows it to drain thoroughly and prevent it from becoming soggy
NON-SLIP BASE -Textured base on the bottom of the shower soap holder keeps it in place and prevents it from sliding on wet surfaces
IDEAL SIZE - Each dish measures 0.75" x 3.25" x 4.75" to fit in compact spaces on countertops; the soap dish with drain is great for use in the bathroom, shower, kitchen, or laundry room
description: The Set of 3 iDesign Soap Savers are your solution to keeping soap bars clean and dry. This responsibly designed plastic soap dish keeps bar soap at hand near the sink while protecting surfaces from soap residue and excess water. The soap bar holder’s open design allows soap to dry more efficiently after use, while the textured base on the bottom of the dish keeps it in place and prevents it from sliding on wet surfaces. This bar soap holder for showers accommodates most brands of bar soap and is great for use in the bathroom, kitchen, laundry room, or next to any sink around the home. The durable plastic construction stands up to everyday use and is easy to clean. This soap dish for shower and kitchen soap tray measures 0.75" x 3.25" x 4.75" to fit perfectly in compact spaces on countertops. iDesign is investing in the future of our planet. We are working towards utilizing post-consumer recycled plastic for our plastic products and incorporating renewable materials.
With iDesign, you can live simply and sustainably every day.
